handoffSay: 📖 The Codex settles deeper into you. It knows things before you do now. Deaths, especially — it will tell you itself.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Kurt Anderson is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Kurt Anderson is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Wei blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
📖 LEARNED: Keeping Morale (Level 1). People need small wins. Celebrate the little things. Despair is the real killer.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Kurt Anderson, 14 days. The mantle passes to Wei Bhatt.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Wei Bhatt, 48 — a musician.
The village's quarrel was with Kurt — and Kurt is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
The fire knew Wei — solid ground, earned at this fire.

📜 Kurt's book stays open on the table: one promise unkept — Omar — haul water from the creek at first light with Omar. The promises died with their maker; the needs didn't. What you do about them is yours to decide.
